summary: Integration brief — annunimas-human-tenant provides Obsidian-compatible vault scanning, frontmatter parsing, wikilink resolution, and semantic-memory record construction (src/lib.rs:1-4,37-42,106-129). MNEMOSYNE is the intended persistent-memory and recall layer, preserving provenance while distinguishing generated recall from canonical truth (src/lib.rs:3-4; docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:115-123). Their shared autonomous-agent safety boundary is classification before reliance: private human material must not become canonical silently, unresolved conflicts require review rather than guessing, and high-risk actions remain governed (docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:21-25,49-69,96-113,145-152). Recommendation: replace the direct Annunimas path dependency with a tenant-facing memory contract and make MemoryStore persist provenance-bearing records only after authority/status policy checks (Cargo.toml:12-15; docs/migration-notes.md:5-10). Human-project risk: MemoryStore currently serializes each record and discards it, so scans appear successful without durable ingestion (src/lib.rs:56-89). MNEMOSYNE-side risk: generated recall may be mistaken for canonical truth unless the required distinction and provenance links are enforced (docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:115-123). The declared clean-tree check completed successfully; inspection was read-only.
